text: dsh-lit-search 为 DSH agent 提供学术文献检索与引用工具，通过 Cordis 注册四个工具：lit_search、lit_cite、lit_bib 和 lit_related。它可跨 Crossref、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 搜索并合并去重论文，支持年份筛选及按引用数或日期排序；也能按 DOI 生成 GB/T 7714、APA、BibTeX 引文，批量整理 BibTeX，并查询 OpenAlex 相关论文。适合需要查找论文和整理参考文献的研究流程。无需 API key，联网使用公开文献 API，可选配置代理。

dsh-lit-search adds four DSH tools for literature search, citations, BibTeX, and related papers. It searches Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar, merges DOI results, and supports year filters and sorting. Format citations as GB/T 7714, APA, or BibTeX. No API key is needed.
我想让 DSH 帮我按关键词找学术论文
有没有工具能跨几个文献数据库合并搜索结果
帮我按 DOI 生成符合 GB/T 7714 的参考文献
我有一串 DOI，想一次导出成 BibTeX 文件内容
想找一篇论文的相关研究和后续阅读线索
搜索论文时能限制发表年份并按引用量排序吗
Find academic papers across multiple scholarly databases by keyword.
Format a DOI as an APA, GB/T 7714, or BibTeX citation.
Create BibTeX entries for several DOIs in one request.
Show me related papers based on a paper DOI.
dsh-lit-search 的功能「跨源论文检索」：lit_search 按关键词并行查询 Crossref、OpenAlex 和 Semantic Scholar，合并 DOI 去重结果；支持发表年份范围及引用数、日期或相关度排序。
dsh-lit-search 的功能「DOI 引文格式化」：lit_cite 接收 DOI，可输出 GB/T 7714、数字编号格式、APA 或 BibTeX；Crossref 未命中时尝试从 OpenAlex 获取记录。
dsh-lit-search 的功能「批量 BibTeX 生成」：lit_bib 接收 DOI 列表，逐条生成 BibTeX 并合并为文本，同时返回无法取得记录的 DOI。
dsh-lit-search 的功能「相关论文查询」：lit_related 根据 DOI 从 OpenAlex 读取 related_works，并返回限定数量的作品元数据。

Academic literature search, citation and BibTeX tools for DeepSeek Harness and
any agent. One package, three forms: dsh Cordis plugin, standalone CLI, and an
agent skill.

dsh-lit-search README · Features：- **Merged search** — keyword search across Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic
  Scholar, deduplicated by DOI, with title/authors/year/venue/citation counts.
  Filter by publication year (`--from`/`--to`) and sort by citations, date or
  relevance (`--sort`).
- **Citation formatting** — GB/T 7714 (default, for Chinese theses), GB/T 7714
  numeric (`[1]`-style, `gbt7714-numeric`), APA, BibTeX.
- **Batch BibTeX** — generate a combined `.bib` for a list of DOIs, with the
  failed DOIs reported separately.
- **Related works** — related papers for a DOI via OpenAlex `related_works`.

dsh-lit-search README · 1. dsh plugin：```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-lit-search
```

Registers four agent tools: `lit_search`, `lit_cite`, `lit_bib`, `lit_related`.

dsh-lit-search README · 2. Standalone CLI：```bash
npx dsh-lit-search search "attention is all you need" -n 5
npx dsh-lit-search search "moe" --from 2024 --sort date
npx dsh-lit-search cite 10.1038/nature14539 -s bibtex
npx dsh-lit-search cite 10.1038/nature14539 -s gbt7714-numeric

All commands print human-readable text by default; pass `--json` before the
subcommand (e.g. `npx dsh-lit-search --json search "transformers"`) for
machine output. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` business error, `2` usage error.

dsh-lit-search README · 3. Agent skill：Copy `skill/` into `~/.agents/skills/dsh-lit-search/` (or your agent's skill
directory). The skill tells the agent to run the CLI above.

dsh-lit-search README · Data sources：- [Crossref](https://www.crossref.org/) — DOI metadata and works search.
- [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org/) — works search, citation counts, related works.
- [Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org/) — works search, citation counts.

All are free public APIs; no API key required. HTTP goes through a single
layer with a 10s timeout, one retry on 5xx/network errors, and a polite
`mailto:` User-Agent.

dsh-lit-search README · MCP server (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, ...)：Use dsh-lit-search from any MCP host via the companion package
[`dsh-lit-search-mcp`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lit-search-mcp)
(listed on the official MCP Registry as `io.github.Flan246/dsh-lit-search`):

```bash
claude mcp add lit-search -- npx -y dsh-lit-search-mcp
```

or in any MCP host's config: `"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "dsh-lit-search-mcp"]`.
